# **Step 11: Preparation of ISM061-13** 

A solution of **compound 13-10** (31 mg, 0.08 mmol) in hydrobromic acid aqueous solution (3 mL) was stirred at 100 °C for 4 hours. After the addition of ice water (10 mL), the mixture was extracted with ethyl acetate (10 mL × 3). The combined organic phases was washed with brine (20 mL), dried over anhydrous sodium sulfate, filtered, and concentrated under reduced pressure to give a residue, which was purified by pre-HPLC to afford the title compound as a white solid (12.4 mg, Y: 41.7%).
